external_asset_dependencies.source: User capture/gallery media supplied at runtime; no static design file SHA exists.

entries.name: Top Title
entries.geometry: Title Only V1; host owns safe inset.
entries.responsive_rule: Remaining width; ellipsis per source contract; may grow for scaled text.
entries.acceptance_rule: At each referenced viewport, the title uses remaining width, remains clear of system insets, and follows registered ellipsis/fontScale behavior.
entries.purpose: Present the page title in the shared top navigation.
entries.visual_rule: Single-line title using remaining navigation width; no status/cutout overlap; fontScale may increase height.
entries.interaction: Read-only navigation label; title truncation follows source contract.

entries.name: Back
entries.responsive_rule: Keep target and 20sp BACK_TITLE; ellipsize at narrow widths.
entries.acceptance_rule: Verify 56dp minimum bar, 44×44dp target, 22dp glyph, 8dp gap, registered SVG, and immediate-parent navigation.
entries.purpose: Return to the immediate parent destination.
entries.visual_rule: Registered back glyph and title; 56dp minimum bar, 44dp target, 22dp glyph and 8dp gap.
entries.interaction: Activation returns to the immediate parent destination.

entries.name: Top Navigation Action
entries.geometry: Page-specific utility order; title uses remaining width.
entries.responsive_rule: Do not reorder actions; title may ellipsize at larger scale.
entries.acceptance_rule: Verify action order and declared icon identity at each page; no extra action or default glass pill; title may ellipsize.
entries.purpose: Expose the page-declared utility action set.
entries.visual_rule: Page-ordered registered utility actions; title uses remaining width; no default pill or added action.
entries.interaction: Dispatch the page-declared action while preserving registered order.

entries.name: Primary Button
entries.geometry: 28dp radius; dimensions stable across states; Result uses explicit page exception.
entries.responsive_rule: Keep label and action reachable; width ratio belongs to consumer contract.
entries.acceptance_rule: Verify each declared normal/pressed/loading/disabled/focus state, 28dp radius exception, label token, and disabled non-activation.
entries.purpose: Present the page's declared primary or secondary action.
entries.visual_rule: Registered primary/secondary semantic surface and state colors; stable dimensions; 28dp frozen radius exception.
entries.interaction: Activates its semantic primary/secondary action; loading blocks duplicate activation; disabled is non-actionable.

entries.name: Text Action
entries.responsive_rule: Single line; retain invisible hit area, no visible pill.
entries.acceptance_rule: Verify 44×44dp target, no visible container, declared tone/chevron and 90ms pressed transition.
entries.purpose: Expose a low-chrome text action with a registered semantic tone.
entries.visual_rule: Containerless semantic label, visible state tone and chevron only when page authority declares it.
entries.interaction: Activates the declared text action; pressed transition follows 90ms source rule; no visible container.

entries.name: Icon Action
entries.responsive_rule: Keep touch target; page contract owns glyph scale.
entries.acceptance_rule: Verify registered SVG, 24×24 viewBox source, 44dp target and declared normal/pressed/disabled/focus state.
entries.purpose: Expose a registered icon action with an accessible action target.
entries.visual_rule: Registered SVG glyph with semantic tone; selected state is consumer-owned.
entries.interaction: Activates the declared icon action; selected state changes only when page owns it.

entries.name: Glass Surface
entries.geometry: GLASS_A/B/C opacity family; page owns padding/radius/height.
entries.responsive_rule: Intrinsic content height and scroll; no stretch to fill viewport.
entries.acceptance_rule: Current source confirms glass colors and no-stretch behavior. Pass generic reuse only after each consumer registers padding/radius/height; currently REVIEW.
entries.purpose: Provide a translucent surface treatment behind page content.
entries.visual_rule: Use registered glass/color treatment; preserve page-owned padding, radius and intrinsic height.
entries.interaction: Non-interactive surface; child controls own hit targets.
token_gap: Generic padding, radius and height tokens are not approved; preserve the consumer page geometry.

unresolved_properties: Generic padding, radius and height tokens are not approved; preserve the consumer page geometry.

entries.name: Card
entries.responsive_rule: Grow with content; no universal ratio/crop.
entries.acceptance_rule: Each consumer must name a card authority and crop/ratio rule. No universal shape is approved; currently REVIEW.
entries.purpose: Group related content using a page-owned card authority.
entries.visual_rule: Use the named page card authority; no universal ratio, crop or shared envelope.
entries.interaction: No action unless the page contract explicitly declares navigation or selection.
token_gap: Generic card envelope, radius, ratio and crop are not approved; each consumer must cite its Frozen authority.

unresolved_properties: Generic card envelope, radius, ratio and crop are not approved; each consumer must cite its Frozen authority.

entries.name: Hero
entries.geometry: Page Frozen outer frame; HOME/DETAIL use HERO_ADAPTIVE.
entries.responsive_rule: Trusted safe Fill or same-source Safe Fit + ambient; no stretch.
entries.acceptance_rule: Verify source bytes unchanged, approved frame, safe Fill or Safe Fit, and no crop outside FishSafeRect.
entries.purpose: Present the primary catch or species media in its frozen frame.
entries.visual_rule: Use the frozen frame and declared safe Fill or Fit mode; preserve source bytes and subject-safe crop.
entries.interaction: Media display only unless a page contract explicitly declares interaction.

entries.name: Image
entries.geometry: Consumer-owned content rect; no non-uniform scaling.
entries.responsive_rule: Evidence Fit or subject-safe crop per media role.
entries.acceptance_rule: Verify declared mode, source preservation, loading/ready/fallback/error and no non-uniform stretch.
entries.purpose: Present source imagery with its declared crop/fit behavior.
entries.visual_rule: Preserve aspect ratio and use the named image mode; no non-uniform scale.
entries.interaction: Media display only unless a page contract explicitly declares interaction.

entries.name: Video
entries.visual: FishRecordDetail media contracts; Fish Media Display V1
entries.geometry: Container/aspect remains consumer-owned; no universal video ratio found.
entries.responsive_rule: Fit/cover and controls per page contract; respect Insets.
entries.acceptance_rule: Verify page frame/aspect, not_added/ready/playing/paused/failed and control reachability; shared frame is not frozen.
entries.purpose: Present page-owned video media and playback states.
entries.visual_rule: Page-scoped video frame and controls; generic aspect/control contract remains open.
entries.interaction: Page-declared playback controls; not_added → ready → playing/paused or failed.
token_gap: No shared aspect ratio or control geometry authority.

unresolved_properties: No shared aspect ratio or control geometry authority.

entries.name: Metadata Row
entries.geometry: Row height, icon alignment, truncation page-specific.
entries.responsive_rule: Wrap or ellipsize only per field contract.
entries.acceptance_rule: Every field must have source, long/missing behavior, type/color refs and documented row alignment; shared geometry is not frozen.
entries.visual_rule: Label/value hierarchy uses shared type/color tokens; field geometry remains page-scoped.
entries.interaction: Read-only display unless a page contract explicitly enables editing.
token_gap: Shared row height, icon alignment, wrapping and truncation are not approved across pages.

unresolved_properties: Shared row height, icon alignment, wrapping and truncation are not approved across pages.

entries.name: Statistic Card
entries.visual: Normal Home V1.1 typography / NH04 states
entries.geometry: Home statistic group geometry only; no shared card contract.
entries.responsive_rule: Preserve Home groups and page-specific Font A.
entries.acceptance_rule: Compare Normal Home group to its page authority, preserve Numeric/Caption roles, and do not promote Font A to a global scale.
entries.purpose: Present a numeric statistic and its supporting label.
entries.visual_rule: Read-only numeric group using Numeric/Caption; Normal Home Font A stays a page override.
entries.interaction: Read-only value group; no action without a page contract.
token_gap: Shared statistic-card geometry is not approved; Normal Home Font A remains page-scoped.

unresolved_properties: Shared statistic-card geometry is not approved; Normal Home Font A remains page-scoped.

entries.acceptance_rule: Pass only after C-014 closes with visual, behavior, accessibility, runtime and acceptance states; currently REVIEW.
entries.purpose: Choose a species or other declared option using the registered picker authority.
entries.visual_rule: Selector visual uses Species Picker authority; shared focus, accessibility and empty/error contract remains open.
entries.interaction: Closed → open → searching/selected/empty/error according to Species Picker page flow.

entries.acceptance_rule: Verify idle/focus/typing/results/empty/clear/error, IME insets and query retention; shared geometry remains REVIEW.

entries.visual_rule: Search field is IME-aware; preserve query and visible content; focus/clear/empty states remain explicit.
